floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.
Region A quantified as a pure sum/j $a0<->$a1 swap (all surroundings match target); naive structural levers KILLED, pointing to the directed permuter.

Region A range-mechanism CONFIRMED: offset+=j flips the sum/j a0/a1 swap (score 7) but is not match-viable; zero-cost manual flips killed, so the flip needs the directed permuter's whole-function LUID
Directed permuter (real full-TU basin) found do-while(0) on sum=0 that solves Region A and lowers the honest floor 8->6; Region B has no clean permuter lever (all sub-130 finds invalid).

frontier.hypothesis: The residual 2-insn Region-A preheader tie (bp-addu vs sum-move order) is closable by a source/scheduling perturbation stacked on the do-while(0).
frontier.mechanism: The do-while(0) reordered the preheader so sum's move now precedes bp's addu (opposite of target). A different init spelling/placement (e.g. wrapping bp=base+offset, or moving the do-while(0) earlier/later) may restore target order without disturbing the solved Region A allocation.
frontier.next_probe: From the floor-6 chassis, permute ONLY the inner-loop preheader statement order (j=0; bp=base+offset; do{sum=0}while(0);) via PERM_LINESWAP / do-while(0) placement variants; keep any variant holding score<=6 that emits `addu $v1,$t1,$a3` before `move $a1,$zero`. Watch the objdump lines 5-7.

frontier.hypothesis: Region B needs a genuine control-flow change (not an alias) to make the LICM range-check constants materialize before the ap/a2p moves.
frontier.mechanism: The constants (0x80000000, 0x1FFFFF) are LICM-hoisted to preheader END; only restructuring WHERE the range check materializes (e.g. computing the check bound outside the loop legitimately, or a different loop shape) can lower their LUID below the moves without a constant-holder cheat or wrong-type alias.
frontier.next_probe: Diagnose whether the pointer-range test `(u32)(ptr-0x80000000)<=0x1FFFFF` can be spelled so GCC does NOT LICM-hoist the two constants into the same preheader block; vet any form against the constant-holder / offset-steering cheat catalog before proposing.
